title: Pocket Rally
pitch: Three tiny circuits built for time trials, visible racing lines and a local best-lap ghost.
capabilities: Camera follow and layered track rendering
Local ghost replay and HUD animation
rules: Steer, accelerate and brake a top-down car. Race three laps; gates must be crossed in order and direction.
Offroad slows the car; reset-to-track adds a penalty. No damage economy or multiplayer.
Ghost is a recorded pose trace of a completed valid lap, not a simulated opponent.
content: Three original tracks, time trial and medal targets, one car with two handling presets.
state: best laps and validated pose traces
